name: fsa_fhrs_london_food_hygiene
title: Food hygiene ratings (FHRS) for every rated food business in London
description: Every establishment rated under the Food Hygiene Rating Scheme in the 33 London local authorities (the 32 boroughs plus the City of London Corporation): business name and type, address, geocode, current rating, inspection date and the three component scores. The FSA publishes one XML file per authority, regenerated daily, and keeps no public history — each day's extract overwrites the last — so the weekly commits and monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags on this repo form a longitudinal record of London's food-business landscape that exists nowhere else.

sources.title: Food Standards Agency — Food hygiene ratings (FHRS) open data

update_cadence: The FSA regenerates every local authority's file daily, so unlike the quarterly/annual statistical sources in this repo, every weekly pipeline run should detect changes; the underlying ratings change continuously as inspections happen.
caveats: A rating reflects the establishment's most recent inspection, which can be years old — check rating_date before treating ratings as current conditions.
rating_value is not always numeric: alongside 0-5 it can be 'Exempt', 'AwaitingInspection' or 'AwaitingPublication', so it is kept as text in the merged table.
The component scores (hygiene, structural, confidence in management) count points deducted — lower is better — and are absent for exempt/unrated establishments.
Some records lack geocodes and/or postcodes; do not assume every row can be mapped.

Establishments belong to the *inspecting* authority (normally where the premises sit). London counts include the City of London Corporation, whose remit also covers some markets outside the Square Mile.

The FSA publishes current state only, with no public archive — the history of these files accumulates in this repo's weekly commits and monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags, and in catalog.json's git history in the pipeline repo.

The XML header embeds the FSA's daily ExtractDate, so the raw zip's hash changes on every weekly run even in the (rare) weeks where no rating actually changed — a 'changed' zip does not by itself mean ratings moved.

resources.name: merged_parquet
resources.description: All 33 authorities merged into one table, one row per establishment, with a local_authority column added. All columns are strings (rating_value is not always numeric). Best-effort derived file; the raw XML zip is authoritative.

fields.name: local_authority
fields.description: Inspecting London authority (added by the merge; not in the FSA XML rows).

fields.name: fhrs_id
fields.description: FSA's unique establishment id.

fields.name: local_authority_business_id
fields.description: The authority's own id for the business.

fields.name: business_name
fields.description: Trading name.

fields.name: business_type
fields.description: FSA business type label (e.g. Restaurant/Cafe/Canteen).

fields.name: business_type_id
fields.description: FSA business type code.

fields.name: address_line_1
fields.description: Address line; may be empty.

fields.name: address_line_2
fields.description: Address line; may be empty.

fields.name: address_line_3
fields.description: Address line; may be empty.

fields.name: address_line_4
fields.description: Address line; may be empty.

fields.name: post_code
fields.description: Postcode; may be empty.

fields.name: rating_value
fields.description: 0-5, or 'Exempt'/'AwaitingInspection'/'AwaitingPublication' — hence string.

fields.name: rating_key
fields.description: FSA's internal key for the rating image/label.

fields.name: rating_date
fields.description: ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd) of the most recent inspection; empty when unrated.

fields.name: new_rating_pending
fields.description: 'True' when a newer rating awaits publication.

fields.name: score_hygiene
fields.description: Points deducted — lower is better; empty for exempt/unrated.

fields.name: score_structural
fields.description: Points deducted — lower is better; empty for exempt/unrated.

fields.name: score_confidence_in_management
fields.description: Points deducted — lower is better; empty for exempt/unrated.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: WGS84 longitude as published; may be empty.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: WGS84 latitude as published; may be empty.

resources.name: raw_xml_zip
resources.description: The 33 unmodified FSA XML files (FHRS<code>en-GB.xml, codes 501-533) bundled into one deterministic zip — the archival record, reprocessable if the merged table ever needs rebuilding or extending.
